candidates.change_summary: Replace setting betLimit with setting a different state variable (difficulty) so AdjustBetAmounts no longer updates betLimit.
Assign betLimit to amount plus 1, changing the resulting betLimit value after the call.
Prevent betLimit from being changed by removing the assignment and only emitting the event (no state update).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the ownership check, enabling non-owners to call AdjustBetAmounts and thus change betLimit when previously they could not.
